description_expanded: This 4-bedroom home is located between the Caliza Pool and ZUMA fitness center and overlooks Arboleda park. The courtyard offers outdoor seating and a private plunge pool that may be heated in the cooler months. The first floor offers a king bedroom with private bath as well as an open-plan great room with a large center kitchen island. On the second floor, guests will find the primary suite with a king-sized bed, another bedroom with king-sized bed and private bath and the laundry room. The third floor has a sitting area along with 4 twin beds tucked away in a loft as well as a terrace overlooking the park. The fourth bedroom is detached from the main house and offers a private suite with a king-sized bed, sitting area and full kitchen located above the garage. Parking for this home is a two-vehicle garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
